title: A Sunset Dhow Cruise: What to Expect
excerpt: A sunset cruise on a traditional dhow is a classic Zanzibar experience. What to expect and how to choose a good trip.
body:
## The dhow

Dhows are traditional wooden sailing boats with a triangular sail, used on the Indian Ocean for centuries.

## The cruise

Usually one to two hours around sunset, with drinks, snacks and sometimes music.

## Where

From Stone Town, Nungwi and Kendwa, where the sun sets over the sea.

## Tips

- Choose a boat with life jackets.
- Ask whether drinks are included.
- Bring a light jacket.

See [romantic experiences](/blog/romantic-safari-experiences/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
